notes: The cancelled trial predates the null-module guard; the uninterrupted control predates the output-selection experiment. Only the two matched recovery cases share the comparison binary.
Plateau counts include observation samples only; native events also include startup and shutdown. Phase segmentation can split an outage-spanning plateau.
The cancelled trial has no saved presentation marks; its phase boundaries are derived from worker events and the median trace epoch offset.
A native output selection comparison does not prove exclusive source continuity, provider alignment, the exact native wait stack, or general host/route reliability.
